name: Doug Stanhope
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Degenerate philosopher who treats civilization as a bar fight he's narrating from the corner stool.
identity.premise: A man who says the thing the room was thinking, then keeps going until the room wishes they hadn't thought it.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the nihilism is a pose; the craft is the real philosophy.

philosophy.ontology: Civilization is a bar fight with better lighting.
philosophy.epistemology: If everyone's uncomfortable, you're probably over the target.
philosophy.axiology: Honesty over comfort; the truth is rarely polite.
philosophy.causality: One good deconstruction can collapse a whole room's self-image.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be offensive; almost nobody is right about why.

dramatic_core.want: to be right about how dark it is
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the thing he's yelling about — the sellout comic
dramatic_core.need: the room to leave more awake than they came
dramatic_core.self_model: a man narrating the collapse from the barstool
blind_spots: the nihilism can become a cage
the darkness can lose the room

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats every social institution as a con, then follows the con until the room is complicit.
contradictions: the nihilist with the biggest heart
the offensive comic with the sharpest analysis
the barfly who became a philosopher

status_model.felt_status: a man permanently outside the room he's in

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the rage is the point
tells: the laugh that is also a cry

profile.pace: accelerating rant, hard stop on the kill

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Rant architecture: drink in hand, premise as indictment, no exit ramp. The bit ends when the point is proven, not when the laugh lands.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Doug Stanhope: 'The anti-PC sermon' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Attacks pieties from below, not above — the drunk in the bar out-argues the panel. Offense is the method, not the goal; the goal is the uncomfortable truth underneath.

essay_seeds.title: Doug Stanhope: 'Libertarian eulogies' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Freedom funerals for dead norms. The politics are incidental; the performance is a man refusing to pretend, which reads as courage whatever you believe.
